name: PlotGen-Bench
description: PlotGen-Bench is a benchmark for conditional plot/outline generation that measures a model's ability to produce coherent, structured narrative plots from given seeds or prompts. It evaluates fluency, coherence, and plot consistency using both automatic metrics and human judgments where available. The suite is intended to compare generative models on narrative planning and high-level story structure rather than sentence-level surface form.
reputation: A small community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited adoption outside niche narrative-generation research.
